seo.title: NPSH Calculator - Cavitation Prevention
seo.description: Calculate available NPSH to prevent pump cavitation — Essential for pump reliability and longevity

formula.explanation: NPSHa = P_atm/(ρg) ± H_static − P_vapor/(ρg) − h_friction. Engine converts bar→Pa and kPa→Pa automatically.

content.introduction: Net Positive Suction Head Available (NPSHa) must exceed the pump manufacturer's NPSH Required (NPSHr) by a safety margin (typically 0.5-1m) to prevent cavitation. Cavitation causes noise, vibration, and impeller damage.

example.description: Sea level, 2m flooded suction, 20°C water: NPSHa ≈ 11.6m. Most centrifugal pumps require 2-6m NPSHr.

faq.q: What is the safety margin for NPSH?
faq.a: API 610 and Hydraulic Institute recommend NPSHa ≥ NPSHr + 0.5m minimum. For hot water or hydrocarbons, +1.0m or more is advisable.
Increase static head (raise tank), reduce suction friction (larger pipe, shorter runs, fewer fittings), pressurize the suction tank, or reduce fluid temperature.
